title: Use listing-based location recommendations instead of paid Google Places autocomplete

requirements.text: Update the public search Location autocomplete to recommend locations/building names only from existing property listings (stored properties), and do not call Google Places Autocomplete so the app does not incur Google API charges.

quotes: getting api is charging do one thing recommend locations on search that location written listings

acceptanceCriteria: Typing in the Location field shows an autocomplete dropdown populated from the backend stored-property suggestions (location + title) rather than Google Places suggestions.
The frontend does not attempt to load or query Google Places Autocomplete for the public search location typeahead (even if VITE_GOOGLE_PLACES_API_KEY is present).
Selecting a suggestion fills the Location input with the selected suggestion text and keeps existing mouse + keyboard selection behavior (arrow keys, enter, escape).
All user-facing text remains in English (e.g., loading state, error state, empty state, helper text).

requirements.text: Ensure the backend query for listing-based autocomplete suggestions returns a deduplicated, case-insensitive matched list derived from BOTH property.location and property.title, and respects maxResults (default 10 when null).

quotes: recommend locations on search that location written listings

acceptanceCriteria: Calling getBackendAutocompleteSuggestions(input, null) returns up to 10 suggestions matched case-insensitively against both property.location and property.title values.
Returned suggestions are deduplicated case-insensitively (e.g., "Downtown Dubai" and "downtown dubai" are not both returned).
The autocomplete query is publicly accessible (does not require agent code or authentication) and does not trap for unauthenticated callers.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; only introduce backend/migration.mo if a state upgrade is required.
Do not edit files in frontend immutablePaths (compose existing components/hooks instead).
Do not use Google Places Autocomplete for the public search typeahead (avoid paid API usage).
All user-facing text must be in English.
nonGoals: Configuring or enabling Google Cloud billing, APIs, or API key restrictions.
Adding any external database or third-party autocomplete/search service.
